examples.name: Static value
examples.description: A read-only key/value row with a plain text value.

examples.name: Underlined pair
examples.description: Add underline for a bottom border divider between pairs.

examples.name: Inline editable with TextField
examples.description: Pass a TextField with appearance='inline' as children for inline editing. The edit icon provides the affordance.
examples.jsx:
<KeyValuePair label="Client name" underline>
  <TextField appearance="inline" defaultValue="Jane Doe" aria-label="Client name" iconAfter={<EditIcon color="subtle" />} />
</KeyValuePair>

examples.name: Inline editable with TextArea
examples.description: Pass a TextArea with appearance='inline' for multi-line inline editing.
examples.jsx:
<KeyValuePair label="Notes" underline>
  <TextArea appearance="inline" defaultValue="Awaiting trust schedule." aria-label="Notes" rows={2} resize="none" iconAfter={<EditIcon color="subtle" />} />
</KeyValuePair>

examples.name: Small size
examples.description: The sm size uses tighter padding and smaller typography.

antiExamples.name: Without a <dl> parent
antiExamples.reason: <dt>/<dd> elements are semantically meaningful only inside a <dl>. Wrap pairs in a KeyValueList.

antiExamples.name: Using for a form layout
antiExamples.reason: Key Value Pair is for compact metadata display, not full form layouts. Use the Form organism with Field molecules for forms.
